errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the markers for the "Without Implementation" series. While the marker at the "Winter '24" data point appears to be a hollow circle (turquoise border with white fill), the markers at "Fall '24" and "Spring '25" are solid turquoise circles.

This incorrectly describes the markers for the "With Implementation" series. While the marker at the "Winter '24" data point appears to be a hollow square (orange border with white fill), the markers at "Fall '24" and "Spring '25" are solid orange squares.
